import Mathlib

example (a b c : ℕ) (h1 : a = b) (h2 : b = c) : c = a := by
  rw [h1, h2]

example (a b c : ℕ) (h1 : a = b) (h2 : b = c) : c = a := by
  symm
  exact h1.trans h2

example (a b c : ℕ) (h1 : a = b) (h2 : b = c) : c = a :=
  (h1.trans h2).symm
